scripts.minify: esbuild src/app.src.js --minify --outfile=public/js/app.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/read.src.js --minify --outfile=public/js/read.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/theme.src.js --minify --outfile=public/js/theme.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/edit.src.js --minify --outfile=public/js/edit.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/styles.src.css --minify --outfile=public/css/styles.css --log-level=warning
scripts.prerender: rm -rf dist && cp -r public dist && node tools/prerender.js && node tools/seo.js && mkdir -p dist/admin && cp admin/index.html admin/config.yml dist/admin/
scripts.build: npm run content && npm run minify && npm run prerender
